metadataRaw.title: A BETTER Way to Stretch the Neck
metadataRaw.description:
Here’s a tip on a BETTER way to stretch out and relieve tension in your neck, trap, and shoulder muscles.

One of the BIGGEST issues I've seen due to modern technology is that we are constantly shrugging our shoulders up to our ears, especially due to using cell phones or sitting at a desk or computer for too long of a time. 

So if that sounds familiar, don’t worry because that’s like 99% of the population right there. 

Now, I’m sure that you’ve had NECK PAIN or tightness before and have used a stretch similar to where you grab your neck and then pull it over to one side. 

The PROBLEM is that it’s only addressing the neck, and not hitting the traps and shoulders which are also getting tensed by shrugging due typing or using our phones for hours on end. 

So we can stretch our neck out all day, but if we don't figure out that shrug, it's all going to be just a temporary fix. 

Luckily, one of the EASIEST ways to solve this and help how to release shoulder and trap tension is to incorporate the movement into the stretch you're already doing.

Watch the video and get some neck, trap, and shoulder tension RELIEF!
